description: Three sections that each put out one of two voltages you set by hand, switched between by a gate, a button, or a trigger that toggles them

params.text: Forces its section's gate on for as long as it is held, and in latch mode each press flips the section over
Switches its section between following the gate directly and toggling on each rise of it
Sets the voltage its section puts out while its gate is off, across whichever range the menu chooses
Sets the voltage its section puts out while its gate is on, across whichever range the menu chooses

inputs.text: 2V or more turns the first section's gate on
2V or more turns its own section's gate on; with no cable and cascading left on, the section follows the nearest section above it that has a gate or a pressed button

outputs.text: The LOW or the HIGH voltage of its section, whichever its gate state calls for, with no slew or crossfade between them

notes: the three sections share only the voltage range and the cascading rule; each has its own gate, latch and pair of knobs
every jack is monophonic, whatever is patched in
menu: Range: +/-10V, +/-5V, +/-3V, +/-2V, +/-1V, 0V-10V, 0V-5V, 0V-3V, 0V-2V, 0V-1V — sets the span all six LOW and HIGH knobs work across
Default mode: Gate, Latch — sets which way the latch switches come up after an initialise
Cascading: Disabled, Enabled — sets whether a section with no gate of its own follows the sections above it

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads Gate 1.
inputs.2:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads Gate 2 or Gate 1.
